title: Nama Produk vs Isi Kurikulum
author: Rahmat Wibowo, CEO Infraloka
description: Laporan kesadaran konsumen: tinjauan atas klaim pemasaran satu program pelatihan “AI-Powered Data Analysis” (16 jam, Rp 2.140.000 per peserta). Membandingkan nama program dengan enam modul kurikulum yang dipublikasikan, memakai analisis lima dimensi, matriks temuan dan tingkat risiko, serta rekomendasi. Skor komposit kesesuaian klaim terhadap isi yang dilaporkan: 3,6 dari 10.
note: Dokumen menyatakan dirinya edukasi literasi konsumen, bukan opini hukum, bukan tuduhan pidana, dan bukan vonis final atas itikad penyelenggara. Kesimpulannya berlaku sejauh program dijalankan seperti yang dijelaskan pada halaman pendaftaran, berdasarkan empat tangkapan layar halaman publik.

en.title: Product Name vs Curriculum Content
en.description: A consumer-awareness report: a review of the marketing claims of one "AI-Powered Data Analysis" training programme (16 hours, Rp 2,140,000 per participant). It compares the programme name with the six published curriculum modules, using a five-dimension analysis, a findings and risk-level matrix, and recommendations. Composite score for how well the claim matches the reported content: 3.6 out of 10.
en.note: The document states that it is consumer-literacy education, not a legal opinion, not a criminal accusation and not a final verdict on the organiser's good faith. Its conclusion holds as far as the programme is run as described on the registration page, based on four screenshots of public pages.
